newsitem.title: CANADA: U.S. consortium to buy Canada gas trading firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. consortium to buy Canada gas trading firm.

text.p: Enerchange LLC, a joint venture formed by four U.S. energy companies, said on Tuesday it signed a letter of intent to acquire Calgary-based Energy Exchange Inc, a unit of Direct Energy Marketing Ltd.
Enerchange said the deal would include full ownership rights to QuickTrade, a computer-based natural gas trading system that provides links to markets throught the United States and Canada.

The system would complement other Enerchange businesses which include hub administration, as well as operation of the Chicago, Ellisburg-Leidy Northeast and California Energy gas hubs, the statement said.
The acquisition was expected to close this month. The price of the deal was not disclosed.
Enerchange partners include NGC Corp, NICOR Inc, Pacific Enterprises and National Fuel Gas Co.
